purpose: Descriptive application-fit audit for a newly specified incoming-structure quota sensitivity task; no classifier-flip or causal claim.

dataset.patterns_file: Not used: newly retrieved bytes do not match the prior notebook's expected hash.

identity.event_id: Zero-based original CSV data-row position, stable across sorting; identical rows remain distinct.
identity.account_id: Tuple of canonical nonnegative decimal bank ID and unchanged account string; no account-only joins.
identity.timestamp: Exact source minute parsed with YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM; integer minutes since Unix epoch without assigning an unprovided source timezone.
identity.strictness: All events at the target minute are excluded. Walk extension requires strictly increasing original timestamps.

cohort.unit: Distinct destination account and transaction-minute pair
cohort.selection: Lowest SplitMix64 hash of packed account/time key xor seed, breaking hash ties by packed key, from all pairs with a complete 24-hour lookback.
cohort.dependence: Queries may share accounts/events; descriptive query rates are not independent trial estimates or account-uniform prevalence.

query_variants.name: all_transactions
query_variants.filter: None: all payment formats and self-transactions retained.

query_variants.name: nonself_transactions
query_variants.filter: Exclude source==destination before neighborhood construction. This changes the task and is reported separately; it is not an equivalent reduction of the primary query.

context.semantic_history: All qualifying dataset transactions in the lookback window.
context.candidate_vertices: Root plus every account with directed static distance at most three to the root in the semantic history.
context.candidate_events: Every original qualifying event with both endpoints in candidate_vertices, including loops and crossedges.
context.exactness: Every root-ending length-two or length-three tuple lies in this induced context. This preserves the two quota features for all deletion sets; it does not preserve arbitrary classifier features.
context.temporal_core: All original event IDs participating in any factual strict root-ending length-two or length-three tuple. Never choose one tree, discard a conflicting relevant edge, or clone role decisions.
context.limit_policy: Mark incomplete and include in the total cohort denominator; never truncate a context and report it as eligible.

eligibility: each other account has one distinct successor
diagnostics: Induced-context and exact-core structural eligibility, each also conditional on W3>0
All completion and exclusion counts, overlapping structural violation categories
W2, W3, event counts, role overlap, context/core event retention
R=floor(W2/20) and floor(W2/10), explicitly induced by diagnostic 95% and 90% preservation policies
Post-selection event labels: core counts, all-unlabelled and any-labelled root-ending tuple counts; no assumption that touching a labelled event identifies a coherent laundering pattern

optimization_pilot.selection: First 32 nontrivial eligible all-transactions cores in frozen hash order. If fewer, use all. Secondary nonself cases are reported separately and capped at32 by the same rule.
optimization_pilot.scope: Feasibility, original-ID witness validation and whether preservation changes optimum/infeasibility within budget3. One run per method/query; no speedup or runtime-superiority claim.
optimization_pilot.statuses: UNKNOWN or TIMEOUT never counts as INFEASIBLE.
